Summarize this support ticket in 2–3 sentences:

Ticket #4521 — Customer: Jane Doe
Submitted: 2024-11-14
Subject: Charged twice for the same subscription

I noticed two charges of $49.99 on my credit card on November 1st and November 3rd. I only have one active Business Plan subscription and I did not upgrade or make any changes. I have attached my bank statement. I need a refund for the duplicate charge immediately and I have already filed a dispute with my bank.

Priority: High | Tags: billing, duplicate-charge, refund

Summarize this support ticket in 2–3 sentences:

Ticket #4788 — Customer: Raj Patel
Submitted: 2024-11-15
Subject: Two-factor authentication codes not arriving

I set up 2FA last week with my phone number +1-555-0192. Since this morning I am not receiving the SMS codes at all. I tried resending 3 times. I need to log in urgently for a client presentation. I checked my phone signal — it is fine. I also tried a different browser. Nothing works. Please help ASAP.

Priority: Critical | Tags: auth, 2fa, login-blocked

Summarize this support ticket in 2–3 sentences:

Ticket #5012 — Customer: Acme Corp (via API)
Submitted: 2024-11-15
Subject: Intermittent 429 errors on /reports endpoint

Since the November 14 platform update we are receiving sporadic HTTP 429 responses from your /reports/generate endpoint. This happens roughly every 10th request even though we are well within our stated 1000 req/min quota. Our API key is active and unchanged. The 429 body contains 'burst_limit_exceeded' rather than 'rate_limit_exceeded'. We have not changed our request patterns. This is breaking our nightly batch job.

Priority: High | Tags: api, rate-limit, regression

Draft a professional reply email to this customer complaint about a billing error:

Customer: Jane Doe | Issue: Charged twice ($49.99) on the same subscription on Nov 1 and Nov 3.

Action taken: Duplicate charge confirmed. Refund of $49.99 initiated today, expected 5–7 business days. Apology offered. No further action needed from customer.

Draft a concise follow-up email to send 48 hours after a product demo:

Prospect: Sarah Kim, Head of Operations at NovaCorp
Demo date: 2024-11-14
Topics covered: Workflow automation, reporting dashboard, Slack integration
Next step agreed: Sarah will share the tool internally and reply by Nov 20 with questions
Tone: Friendly and professional, not pushy

Draft a customer-facing email announcing planned maintenance downtime:

Scheduled window: Saturday 2024-11-23, 02:00–05:00 UTC
Impact: The app will be read-only. No data will be lost. API calls will return HTTP 503 with Retry-After header.
Reason: Database infrastructure upgrade
Tone: Clear, calm, apologetic for inconvenience

Answer the user's question using the provided help article context.

User question: How do I reset my password?

Context:
---
To reset your password, click 'Forgot password' on the login page. Enter the email address associated with your account. You will receive a reset link within 2 minutes. The link expires after 30 minutes. If you do not receive the email, check your spam folder or contact support. For accounts using SSO, password reset must be done through your identity provider.
---

Answer the user's question using the provided help article context.

User question: How do I cancel my subscription?

Context:
---
You can cancel your subscription at any time from Settings > Billing > Cancel Plan. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period — you retain full access until then. Data is retained for 90 days after cancellation. After 90 days, all data is permanently deleted. To cancel immediately and receive a prorated refund, contact support. Annual plans cancelled within 14 days of renewal are eligible for a full refund.
---

Answer the user's question using the provided help article context.

User question: How long do you keep my data?

Context:
---
Active accounts: data is retained indefinitely while the subscription is active. Cancelled accounts: data is retained for 90 days after cancellation, then permanently deleted. Deleted projects: moved to trash immediately, permanently deleted after 30 days unless restored. Log data (audit logs, access logs): retained for 12 months regardless of account status. Backups: daily backups are kept for 30 days. We comply with GDPR data retention obligations.
---
